children: Mercer International Inc. reached restructuring support agreements with holders of more than 87% of its senior notes and a majority of common shares. The plan addresses $1.275B of notes and provides $400M of fully backstopped new capital; existing shares will be cancelled upon completion.

AI Analyst View
$1.275B of senior notes addressed
The recapitalization targets a substantial debt burden; the release gives no prior-period comparison.
$400M of fully backstopped new capital
New capital is intended to provide liquidity, but completion remains subject to conditions.
Existing common stock will be cancelled
Current shareholders are exposed to dilution and a change in their securities; they are to receive pro rata shares of new common and convertible preferred stock.
Company expects to commence prepackaged Chapter 11 cases
The bankruptcy process and expected Nasdaq delisting create material trading and execution risks.
Completion targeted by end of 2026
This is the company's expected timeline, subject to customary conditions and required approvals.
Up to $300M in new revolving credit commitments
The proposed facilities could add liquidity, but the amount is a maximum and terms are not specified.
Context by AI Analyst

This is an acute balance-sheet restructuring following the company's decision not to make an October 1, 2026 interest payment on its 2028 notes. The next catalysts are creditor and shareholder approvals, court approval and completion of the Chapter 11 process, alongside clarity on new financing and the status of the stock listing.
